gaps.explanation: All seven governmental fund columns of the GAAP Statement of Revenues, Expenditures and Changes in Fund Balances (pp7, 9) are in detail[], from the Budget and Actual (Budget Basis) schedules (pp14-20). GAAP total revenues vs budget-basis printed totals: General 29,737,771 vs 29,259,759 (p14) +478,012; Debt Service 5,349,135 vs 5,234,923 (p17) +114,212; Keno 1,319,280 vs 1,321,638 (p15) -2,358; Capital Improvements 470,572 vs 470,571 (p18) +1; Economic Development 221,086 vs 242,071 (p19) -20,985; 84th Street Redevelopment 4,538,561 vs 4,415,502 (p20) +123,059; Police Academy 275,634 vs 275,634 (p16) 0; basis total 691,941. The other 25,000: the Capital Improvement Fund budget schedule (p18) prints only Interest income 445,571 but Total revenues 470,571 (the report does not add up; the 25,000 is the Intergovernmental 25,000 on the GAAP fund statement p7, not printed as a schedule row). 691,941 + 25,000 = 716,941 = gap (statement 41,912,039 p9, schedules 41,195,098). No fix.

GAAP total expenditures (pp7, 9) vs budget-basis schedule totals: General 27,461,697 vs 27,100,955 (p14; lines add to 27,100,954) +360,742; Debt Service 4,750,096 vs 4,683,425 (p17) +66,671; Keno 735,512 vs 726,193 (p15) +9,319; Capital Improvements 7,048,528 vs 7,256,239 (p18) -207,711; Economic Development 4,147,493 vs 1,147,493 (p19) +3,000,000 (GAAP Community development 3,000,000 p9 is an accrual; p19 shows basis differences (3,020,985)); 84th Street 3,655,892 vs 3,640,537 (p20) +15,355; Police Academy 232,608 vs 238,113 (p16) -5,505. Sum 3,238,871 + 1 General Fund schedule rounding = 3,238,872 = gap. No fix.

Statement Total Governmental Funds prints Transfers, net (178,706) (p10). Detail records transfers gross per fund: General (1,236,536) p14 and Keno (405,630) p15 = 1,642,166 out; Debt Service +300,000 p17, Capital Improvement +434,628 p18, Economic Development +728,832 p19 = 1,463,460 in; net (178,706) = statement (same amounts as the GAAP fund columns pp8, 10). Gross-vs-net only. No fix.
